note: This descriptor is committed BEFORE the tag exists, so it deliberately does not
contain its own commit SHA. upgrade.sh resolves the authoritative commit with
git rev-parse <tag>^{commit} and requires HEAD to equal it.
On review approval: merge to main, set status to "released", then create and
push the annotated tag whose name equals releaseTag. Devices never track a
floating branch; they always pin to a tag via deploy/upgrade.sh.

dist.reason: dist is gitignored and rebuilt locally from the tagged sources; a byte-identical rebuild is not guaranteed across Node/平台 versions, so drift is reported and only gated with --strict.
